name: How do I ensure my renovation project stays within budget?

mainEntity.name: How do I ensure my renovation project stays within budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: To keep your renovation project within budget, clear communication with your contractor about financial limits is essential from the outset. Detailed proposals and contracts help prevent unexpected costs. A key decision factor is making material and design choices early and sticking to them; frequent changes or upgrades during the project are common causes of budget overruns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure your project stays on budget with clear communication, detailed contracts, and by finalizing material and design choices early to avoid costly changes.
